title: The Depot
summary: A twelve-work collection where the CSS :target selector rations display to one painting at a time — and none until you name it in the URL.
mechanism: Pure-CSS :target pseudo-class (zero JavaScript): the URL fragment can light at most one work and by default lights none, enacting the museum's one-on-view / rest-in-storage policy.
references: net.art (the URL fragment / CSS :target as material)
